messages:
aj: quick question — our Go client is misbehaving in a VPC setup. We have a local unix socket at /var/run/redwood.sock (plumbed through our sidecar) and the app also sets HTTP_PROXY for other external services. SDK seems to pick the HTTP proxy and streaming fails. expected behavior?

sophie: hmm, we had a similar report from mobile in Jan. The intended precedence is: 1) explicit SDK config (base_url or socket_path) 2) NO_PROXY exceptions 3) env proxy (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY) fallback. But some language clients check env early.

aj: confirmed — in go-client code path it does `if env proxy set -> use proxy` before checking `cfg.SocketPath`. so explicit socket never wins.

sophie: not great. For unix sockets we also support special base_url forms like `unix:///var/run/redwood.sock` which should bypass HTTP proxy parsing entirely. Are you using socket_path or a special base_url?

aj: using SocketPath field in our client config (we pass path in NewClient opts). Not the unix:// URL.

sophie: okay. two fixes: accept SocketPath as highest priority, and normalize socket-style base_urls so we skip proxy env parsing. Also need to handle Windows named pipes (\.\pipeedwood) similarly.

nathan: add a small repro snippet and I'll poke at the Go SDK. Repro idea: set `HTTP_PROXY=http://10.0.0.5:3128` and `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1` then init client with SocketPath "/var/run/redwood.sock" and call streaming endpoint. Should reproduce.

liam: fyi node and python SDKs have slightly different heuristics — node checks `opts.proxy` then `process.env` then `opts.socketPath`, which is the wrong order. we should align across SDKs.

sophie: proposal: SDKs must implement precedence in this order (documented): 1) explicit option in constructor (socketPath/baseUrl/proxy) 2) explicit per-request override 3) NO_PROXY match (if host matches NO_PROXY treat like no proxy) 4) env proxies 5) default direct. Also document that `unix://` and `npipe://` base_urls always bypass proxy parsing.

aj: sounds good. I'll open a tiny RFC in devex/docs about this priority and add a checklist for language SDKs.

liam: I'll make a cross-SDK lint rule in our monorepo to assert the order (unit tests) — will need folks to add the test harness.

sophie: thanks. Nathan, can you do the Go PR? aj can add the tests/rfc.

nathan: yep. I'll put up a draft PR tonight: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-client/pull/XXXX (draft) :eyes: 

aj: thanks all. one more edge: if user sets REDWOOD_BASE_URL="https://private.local" and socketPath present, we should treat explicit socketPath as higher priority (even if base_url is present) — basically explicit path > explicit URL. I'll add that note.

devex-bot: action created: devex/SDKSOCKET-18 "Enforce socket/baseurl/proxy precedence across SDKs" assigned to nathan, liam; aj watcher.

liam: pinging @sophie for an API docs blurb — can you add a short example for `unix:///var/run/redwood.sock` and `NO_PROXY` usage?

sophie: on it, will add examples and a quick table of precedence in the SDK docs page.

aj: closing loop — timeline: RFC + tests by EOD Friday, Go PR draft tonight, cross-SDK lint next week. thanks!
